status: Real authentication, persistent sessions and role guards implemented and verified. Phase23 not started.
authentication_architecture: Browser host-only HttpOnly cookie -> FastAPI -> SHA-256 opaque token digest lookup -> active User. No JWT, localStorage identity or frontend secret persistence.

password_hashing.password_policy: Signup/bootstrap 12-128 characters; no password trimming/case normalization; login verifies supplied 1-128 characters.
password_hashing.request_redaction: Pydantic SecretStr and validation error input omission

email_normalization.policy: Trim, syntax validate without DNS/deliverability, ASCII IDNA domain conversion, lowercase entire email; SMTPUTF8/non-ASCII local parts rejected. Full name spelling unchanged except blank names rejected.
email_normalization.legacy_migration: Validate/collision-check all existing identities before updates. Refuse invalid/colliding accounts; do not merge/promote/change profile ownership.

session_design.database_storage: SHA-256 hex digest only; no raw token column
session_design.login_signup_rotation: New token replaces/revokes current browser token if supplied; independent other-device sessions remain.
session_design.logout: Delete supplied DB session; clear cookie; idempotent.
session_design.expiration: Absolute UTC expiry; default 24 hours; SMARTENERGY_SESSION_HOURS integer 1-720, no sliding renewal.
session_design.inactive: Every authentication checks active User; observed inactivity rejects and deletes all user sessions.

cookie_policy.name: smartenergy_session
cookie_policy.secure: SMARTENERGY_COOKIE_SECURE; false for local HTTP, true for HTTPS deployment

CSRF_and_CORS.auth_POST_header: X-SmartEnergy-CSRF: 1 required; non-simple header forces preflight
CSRF_and_CORS.origin_check: Configured frontend origins or own API origin; explicit rejection of untrusted Origin; non-browser missing Origin still requires custom header.
CSRF_and_CORS.hostname_policy: Use localhost consistently; separate unrelated sites not supported by current Lax-cookie architecture.

auth_endpoints.POST /auth/signup: 201 active USER only; extra role/hash fields rejected; duplicate409, invalid422; establishes session.
auth_endpoints.POST /auth/login: 200 safe user/new session; generic401 for wrong/unknown/inactive credentials.
auth_endpoints.GET /auth/me: Safe id/email/full_name/role/is_active; invalid/expired/revoked/inactive401 and stale cookie clear.
auth_endpoints.POST /auth/logout: Revoke/delete supplied session and clear cookie, idempotent200.

response_security: All auth responses no-store; no password_hash, token_hash or raw session token in JSON. Database errors are sanitized; SQL bind parameters hidden.

known_limitations: No production security certification; no rate limiting/lockout/MFA, email ownership verification, password reset/change or external identity provider.
No admin management, building CRUD, measurement entry/import, building-specific prediction or prediction persistence APIs; existing admin shell remains unavailable.
Absolute sessions, no session-management UI or scheduled cleanup; unvisited expired rows remain until future housekeeping.
UI revalidation occurs on navigation/focus/foreground interval; server dependencies reject invalid/inactive/expired sessions on every request. Other tabs can retain old UI until their next check.
SameSite Lax requires consistent same-site hostnames; Secure must be explicitly enabled with HTTPS for deployment; trusted proxy/host handling needs deployment review.
Duplicate signup409 intentionally exposes identity existence; login errors stay generic.
SQLite/Alembic cannot reflect expression-index definitions here; actual index SQL and uniqueness tested. Future schema changes must review this index explicitly.
Online migration refuses invalid or colliding legacy identities. Offline SQL requires independent identity prevalidation/normalization before execution.
PostgreSQL offline DDL compilation only, not real PostgreSQL deployment verification; SQLite concurrency limits remain.
Windows Edge verifier depends on installed Edge/websocket-client; external page assets blocked during QA. No large frontend testing framework introduced.
Existing research domain/formatting/environment limitations remain; accounts do not establish multi-building model validity.
